title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Ending
subtitle: 休息休闲 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 休息休闲（生活与学习·休息与休闲）
meta: 主题语境：休息休闲（生活与学习·休息与休闲）　|　核心词汇：dream　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dream 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my aunt ① had a dream that no doctor in the town would have explained, and she said the having was the whole of the winter. The ② dream, meaning the sleep and not the hope, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a dream, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left untold.

Every ③ dream in that town had the same short ending at the end of it, and the ④ dream at the end, meaning the one they kept to themselves and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dream, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to tell; my aunt said the telling is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dream was the whole of the story, meaning the hope and not the sleep. The ⑥ dream, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody speaks of and nobody chases; dream, he said, is either something you have or the only word that means both a sleep and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1955 the ⑦ dream had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short ending. The ⑧ dream of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one town and fourteen winters of telling; dream, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to tell. She said the telling was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dream I remember is the one named in the diary, which came true in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ dream, my mother said in 1969, is the only one that improves by being told; every dream, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a sleep. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 梦（指那个镇子里做过的那一个）
B. n. 梦（指那个梦本身，与理想相对）
C. 固定搭配：have a dream 做一个梦
D. n. 梦（指留给自己的那一个）
E. n. 梦（抽象总称，指一家人的说梦之事）
F. n. 梦（指日记里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 理想；梦想（指故事里人人都谈起却无人去追的那样东西）
H. n. 理想；梦想（抽象总称，指人人都谈起却无人去追的那种东西）

items.q: had a dream that no doctor in the town would have explained
The dream, meaning the sleep and not the hope
the dream was the whole of the story
the dream had become a line in a diary
The dream of the whole thing
A dream, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: have a dream 意为“做一个梦”，1946 年姑姑做了一个镇子上没有一位医生肯解释的梦。
dream 意为“梦”，指那个梦本身而不是理想，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有被记名。
dream 意为“梦”，指那个镇子里的每一个梦，每一个到头都有同样短短的收梢。
dream 意为“梦”，指留给自己的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dream 意为“理想、梦想”，指故事里人人都谈起却无人去追的那样东西，叔叔说这个理想就是那个故事的全部。
dream 意为“理想、梦想”，指人人都谈起却无人去追的那种东西而不是那个梦，是故事里人人都谈起、却无人去追的东西。
dream 意为“梦”，指日记里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1955 年这个梦成了日记里的一行。
dream 意为“梦”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的说梦之事是一个镇子和十四个冬天的讲述。
dream 意为“梦”，我记得的是日记里记下的那一个，1967 年成真了，至今仍被说成镇子里最安静的一个。
dream 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，一个梦是唯一会因为被好好讲述而变得更好的东西。
